LightningComponentBundle.description: Primary site navigation for the Sinclair Brand Portal chrome. Renders the configurable primary menu items, marks the active section (aria-current + red indicator), and collapses to a menu button on small viewports.

property.name: navigationLinkSetDeveloperName
property.label: Navigation Menu Developer Name
property.description: Developer name of the NavigationLinkSet to render (e.g. hfs_Dry_Run_Primary). Reserved for future audience-driven menu rendering.

property.name: menuItemsJson
property.label: Menu Items (JSON)
property.description: Optional JSON array of {label, routeName} overriding the default primary set. Leave empty to use the representative primary items.
